lanes.summary: Scripts-only diff cherry-picks the #3712 cells[] producer and wires `--cells` into scripts/release/models_t1.sh on both hosts. It directly and verifiably resolves all four quorum-2 findings the receipt names: (1) receipt scope corrected to this diff's files, (2) cells_for now raises a named refusal (rc 1, "cells: refused --") when load_rungs fails instead of silently measuring 0 rows, (3) the off-mode prompt is now sized by mode.max_tokens (not the thinking budget), fixed at model_ladder_cells_produce.py's measure_item via `budget = a.max_tokens_thinking if mode == "on" else a.max_tokens`, (4) cmd_measure refuses (rc 2, "cells: refused -- --only ... names no inventory model") when --only matches no inventory row instead of writing 0 cells at rc 0, and model_ladder.sh counts a nonzero cells_rc as RED. Traced the owed_rungs refactor in scripts/lib/model_ladder_cells.py and confirmed it is a byte-for-byte behavioral no-op (extracted, not changed) shared correctly by both judge and producer. Verified internal arithmetic in the new test harness (check_ladder_cells_producer.sh) and fake_apr.py fixture: 2 rungs × 4 verbs × 2 modes = 16 owed cells, 4 `code` cells always fail (backend null, apr's known gap) leaving 12 pass; 4 verbs × 2 modes = 8 refused cells on the capacity-refusal case, matching the case table's asserted counts. The wiring into scripts/model_ladder.sh (enrich always, measure only under --cells) and scripts/release/models_t1.sh (--cells added on both local and remote legs) matches the receipt's described mechanism exactly, and the row-count ratchet bump 37→40 matches the one new `cells-measured` row plus its two new mutants. No test asserts the opposite of the ticket, no gate is weakened, and no receipt claim is unbacked by the diff.

The diff is scoped as claimed — no Rust/contract changes, consistent with section 7's disclaimer that sections 4/6 evidence belongs to earlier bases. The `apr code` backend-null gap is disclosed, not hidden, and correctly explains why this lands on the FINAL path rather than rc.1.
